readmeMarkdown:
PDF Reader — Universal Agent Plugin

Read local PDFs side-by-side with Antigravity, Claude Desktop, and DeepSeek Harness — highlight, switch to Night Mode, crop equations to ask your agent, and sync live to Typora / Markdown.

English · 简体中文

--- ## 🌐 Works Natively Across Three Agent Ecosystems | Host | Visual Reader Experience | MCP & Skill Integration | One-Step Install | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Google Antigravity** | Docked right-hand sidecar pane (`sidecar://pdf-reader/reader/`) | `plugin.json` + `mcp_config.json` + `SKILL.md` + `AGENTS.md` | `agy plugin install ...` or unzip `pdf-reader-v1.1.0.zip` | | **Claude Desktop** *(+ Claude Code)* | Local standalone `pdf.js` web reader (`http://127.0.0.1:18765`, auto-launched on `pdf_open`) | One-click `.mcpb` bundle (`manifest.json`) + `claude_desktop_config.json` + `~/.claude/skills` | Double-click `pdf-reader-v1.1.0.mcpb` or `bash bin/install.sh --target claude-desktop` | | **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)** | Local standalone `pdf.js` web reader (`http://127.0.0.1:18765`, auto-launched on `pdf_open`) | Cordis plugin (`package.json`) + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` (`cordis.patch.yml`) + `.agents/skills` | `bash bin/install.sh --target deepseek-harness` | --- ## ✨ Key Features - **Immersive `pdf.js` 5.4 Reader + Night Mode (`Dark Pages`)**: Smooth continuous reading with an auto-hiding frosted top bar, byte-range streaming for multi-hundred-MB textbooks, one-click **Dark Pages (Night Mode)** (`🌙`), per-book zoom memory, and automatic resume at your last-read page. - **4-Color Semantic Highlighter & Page Notes**: Mark passages as 🟨 **Key Point**, 🟥 **Hard**, 🟩 **Concept**, or 🟦 **Question**, attach inline comments, or press `H` for **Highlighter Pen Mode** (drag-select to highlight immediately, with full `⌘Z` / `⌘⇧Z` undo & redo). - **One-Click Ask, Explain, Translate & Formula Crop**: - Select text or drag a **Crop** box around dense equations, figures, or tables. - **In Antigravity**: Sends directly into the active chat pane and auto-syncs the agent's reply from the session transcript. - **In Claude Desktop & DeepSeek Harness**: Queues the question + cropped PNG in `pdf_current().pending_qa` and copies the structured prompt to your clipboard (`⌘V`) — when the agent calls `pdf_save_answer`, its reply appears live in the Reader's **Q&A** tab and Markdown notes! - **Live Markdown & Typora Sync**: Every highlight, comment, page note, and Q&A pair syncs atomically into `~/Documents/PDF Notes/.md`, grouped by page while preserving your own handwritten summary block (`<!-- My Notes:start ... -->`). Click **Open in Typora** (`☰` or `⋯`) anytime. - **11-Tool MCP Server (`pdf_reader_mcp`)**: Gives any MCP-capable agent live awareness of your open PDF, current page, active text selection, high-DPI page renders (`pdf_page_image`), full-text search, and direct PDF highlighting. --- ## 🚀 Installation ### Prerequisites (All Hosts) - **Node.js** >= 18 (zero `npm install` needed — uses built-in Node APIs only) - **Python 3** with `mcp` and `pymupdf` (or `uv` installed — the launcher auto-detects conda, Homebrew, system Python, or `uv run`): ```bash pip install -r requirements.txt ``` --- ### Quick Install (Any or All Hosts) Clone the repository anywhere and run the unified installer (automatically backs up existing configs before merging): ```bash git clone https://github.com/Aludel/antigravity-pdf-reader cd antigravity-pdf-reader pip install -r requirements.txt # Install for all three hosts at once: bash bin/install.sh --target all # Or target a single host: bash bin/install.sh --target antigravity bash bin/install.sh --target claude-desktop bash bin/install.sh --target deepseek-harness ``` --- ### Host-Specific Setup Details #### 1. Claude Desktop (One-Click `.mcpb` Extension) 1. Download **`pdf-reader-v1.1.0.mcpb`** from [Releases](https://github.com/Aludel/antigravity-pdf-reader/releases/latest). 2. Double-click `pdf-reader-v1.1.0.mcpb` — or open **Claude Desktop → Settings → Extensions → Advanced settings → Install Extension…** and select the `.mcpb` file. 3. Ask Claude: *"Open `~/Downloads/paper.pdf` on page 4 with PDF Reader"* — your browser opens the interactive reader side-by-side with Claude Desktop! *(Manual `claude_desktop_config.json` template is also provided in [`integrations/claude-desktop/claude_desktop_config.example.json`](integrations/claude-desktop/claude_desktop_config.example.json).)* #### 2. DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) `bash bin/install.sh --target deepseek-harness` sets up everything automatically: - Copies `SKILL.md` into `~/.dsh/skills/pdf-reader/SKILL.md` and `~/.agents/skills/pdf-reader/SKILL.md` (and `.agents/skills/pdf-reader/SKILL.md` is bundled in-repo for workspace auto-discovery). - Registers `pdf_reader_mcp` via `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` in `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` ( exposing `mcp__pdf_reader_mcp__pdf_open`, `mcp__pdf_reader_mcp__pdf_current`, etc.) and writes `~/.dsh/mcp.json`. - Also exports a native Cordis plugin entry (`integrations/deepseek-harness/index.mjs` via root `package.json`). See [`integrations/deepseek-harness/cordis.patch.yml`](integrations/deepseek-harness/cordis.patch.yml) for manual profile patching (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`). #### 3. Google Antigravity ```bash # Option A: agy CLI agy plugin install https://github.com/Aludel/antigravity-pdf-reader # Option B: Release zip mkdir -p ~/.gemini/config/plugins unzip pdf-reader-v1.1.0.zip -d ~/.gemini/config/plugins/ ``` --- ## ⌨️ Controls & Shortcuts | Action | Shortcut / Gesture | | :--- | :--- | | Previous / Next page, Jump to page | Scroll, `←` / `→`, or type a page number in the top bar and press `Enter` | | Zoom & Fit mode | `⌘+` / `⌘-`, trackpad pinch, `⌘0` or click **Width / Page** (saved per document) | | Night Mode (`Dark Pages`) | Top-right `⋯` → **Dark Pages** | | Highlight selected text | Select text → click 🟨 **Key Point**, 🟥 **Hard**, 🟩 **Concept**, or 🟦 **Question** | | Highlighter Pen Mode | Click the pen icon or press `H` (drag-select highlights immediately; `Esc` or `⌘E` exits) | | Edit / Recolor / Delete / Follow up | Click any existing highlight on the page to open its popover | | Add a page note | Press `N`, or click **＋ Page Note** inside the `☰` Notes drawer | | Undo / Redo annotations | `⌘Z` / `⌘⇧Z` | | Ask / Explain / Translate selection | Select text → **Ask**, **Explain**, or **Translate** | | Crop equation / figure & ask | Press `/` (or click `?`) → **Capture** → **Crop** → drag box → `Enter` | | Open synced notes in Typora | `☰` drawer → **Open Notes in Typora** (or `⋯` → **Open Notes in Typora**) | --- ## 🛠️ MCP Tools (`pdf_reader_mcp`) | Tool | Description | | :--- | :--- | | `pdf_current` | Returns active PDF, current/visible pages, text selection, `host_mode`, and any queued `pending_qa` | | `pdf_open` | Opens a local PDF in Antigravity's sidecar pane or launches the standalone `pdf.js` web reader | | `pdf_read` | Extracts text for a page spec (`"3"`, `"3-5"`, `"1,4,7-9"`, `"current"`, `"all"`) | | `pdf_search` | Whitespace- and hyphen-tolerant full-text search with context snippets | | `pdf_outline` | Reads PDF metadata and built-in bookmark hierarchy | | `pdf_page_image` | Renders any page to PNG (returned as an MCP `Image`) for equations, figures, tables, or scans | | `pdf_notes` | Lists highlights, comments, page notes, and Q&A items | | `pdf_add_note` | Adds a page note or draws a colored highlight directly onto the PDF | | `pdf_edit_note` | Updates a note's comment/color or deletes it | | `pdf_save_answer` | Archives the agent's answer into the PDF's Q&A tab and synced Markdown file | | `pdf_export_notes` | Syncs the Markdown note file (`~/Documents/PDF Notes/<Title>.md`) and opens it in Typora or Finder | --- ## 📂 Repository Layout ```text plugin.json Antigravity plugin manifest manifest.json Claude Desktop .mcpb extension manifest package.json DeepSeek Harness (dsh) / Cordis package manifest .claude-plugin/plugin.json Claude Code plugin manifest .agents/skills/pdf-reader/ DeepSeek Harness workspace auto-discovered skill mcp_config.json Antigravity MCP server config bin/mcp-launcher.mjs Cross-platform Python/uv auto-discovery stdio launcher bin/run-mcp-server.sh POSIX shell launcher & CLI tool runner bin/install.sh Safe multi-host installer (--target antigravity|claude-desktop|deepseek-harness|all) server/mcp_server.py FastMCP server + standalone reader supervisor + Markdown store sidecars/reader/ Dual-mode pdf.js reader (Antigravity sidecar + standalone HTTP server) integrations/ Ready-to-use configs for Claude Desktop & DeepSeek Harness (cordis.patch.yml) skills/pdf-reader/SKILL.md Cross-host agent skill instructions rules/AGENTS.md Always-on rule for <PDF_READER_REQUEST> prompts assets/ Logo (logo.svg, icon.png) & 5-act camera-tracked showcase (demo.svg) ``` --- ## 📄 License Plugin source code is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). Vendored `pdf.js` (`5.4.624`) remains under its original Apache-2.0 license — see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).
latestReleaseNotes:
Universal **v1.1.0** release of **PDF Reader** (`pdf-reader`) — now working natively across **Google Antigravity**, **Claude Desktop**, and **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)**!

> 📖 Documentation: **[English](https://github.com/Aludel/antigravity-pdf-reader/blob/main/README.md)** · **[简体中文](https://github.com/Aludel/antigravity-pdf-reader/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)**

![PDF Reader Demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aludel/antigravity-pdf-reader/main/assets/demo.svg)

## What's New in v1.1.0

- **3-Host Native Support (`Antigravity` + `Claude Desktop` + `DeepSeek Harness`)**:
  - **Claude Desktop**: One-click `.mcpb` Desktop Extension bundle (`pdf-reader-v1.1.0.mcpb`) + `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` + `~/.claude/skills`.
  - **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)**: Cordis plugin (`package.json` + `integrations/deepseek-harness/index.mjs`), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` profile patch (`cordis.patch.yml`), and auto-discovered `.agents/skills/pdf-reader/SKILL.md`.
  - **Google Antigravity**: Native docked right-hand sidecar pane + `pdf_reader_mcp`.
- **Dual-Mode `pdf.js` Reader**: Automatically launches as a local standalone web reader (`http://127.0.0.1:18765`) when `pdf_open` is called from Claude Desktop or DeepSeek Harness — complete with 4-color highlights, **Night Mode (`Dark Pages`)**, formula crop capture, and **Typora Live Sync**.
- **Cross-Host Q&A Archiving (`pdf_save_answer`)**: Questions asked in the standalone reader queue into `pdf_current().pending_qa` and copy to clipboard; `pdf_save_answer` writes the agent's Markdown explanation straight back to the Reader's **Q&A** tab and `~/Documents/PDF Notes/<Title>.md`.
- **Unified Safe Installer (`bin/install.sh`)**: `bash bin/install.sh --target all` (backs up existing configs automatically).

## Quick Install

| Target | Asset / Command |
| :--- | :--- |
| **All Three Hosts** | `git clone https://github.com/Aludel/antigravity-pdf-reader && cd antigravity-pdf-reader && bash bin/install.sh --target all` |
| **Claude Desktop** | Download **`pdf-reader-v1.1.0.mcpb`** below and double-click (or *Settings → Extensions → Install Extension…*) |
| **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)** | `bash bin/install.sh --target deepseek-harness` |
| **Google Antigravity** | `agy plugin install https://github.com/Aludel/antigravity-pdf-reader` or extract **`pdf-reader-v1.1.0.zip`** into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` |
